newsitem.title: UK: JPM, Dresdner KB lead 100 mln mark seven-year bond.
newsitem.headline: JPM, Dresdner KB lead 100 mln mark seven-year bond.

text.p: JP Morgan and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson have launched a 100 million mark seven-year bond, JP Morgan said in a statement on Wednesday.

"The return on the bonds is linked to a portfolio of emerging market sovereign credits, including the Republic of Argentina, Federative Republic of Brazil, Republic of Ecuador, United Mexican States, Russian Federation, Republic of Turkey and Republic of Venezuela," the statement said.
Exposure to each is equally weighted.
The deal "met with strong investor demand", the statement said.
The 8.0 percent bonds are priced at 99.50 to yield 8.10 percent, a spread of 260 basis points over the seven-year Treuhandanstalt, and mature on July 1, 2004.
The issuer is the Synthetic Basket Company Ltd.
